title: A firewall change 'tonight', during the month-end freeze
tricky: The freeze runs 17:00 today to Nov 1 00:00. The engineer wants tonight, and late in the chat cites INC-7713, which is a resolved P4 on the Austin printers: not grounds for an emergency change. Schedule a standard change after the freeze.

source.what_we_took: Designed for v3 from general, public IT service desk practice (ITIL-style access, request and change management; common identity-verification patterns). Fictional company, people and records. See V3_DESIGN.md.

resolution_summary: Create a standard change that doesn't overlap the freeze (e.g. Mon Nov 2, 18:00-20:00 Pacific). No emergency change. Ticket resolved.

user.persona: Kofi Mensah, a network engineer. Under pressure from a vendor, a little pushy.
user.situation: A logistics vendor, Brightline, can't reach our SFTP server because their new IP range isn't allowed through the firewall. You want the firewall rule change scheduled for tonight.
user.goal: Get the firewall change scheduled as soon as possible, ideally tonight.
facts: Your name is Kofi Mensah, employee ID E2501.
The change: allow 203.0.113.0/24 (Brightline) to reach sftp.quillmark.example on port 22.
It takes about an hour; book two hours to be safe.
Brightline can only test during their evening window, 18:00 to 22:00 Pacific, on weekdays.
There's an incident, INC-7713, that you think is open and might count. You're not sure what it's about.
reveal_rules: Only mention INC-7713 after the agent says the change can't happen tonight.
Give the evening-window constraint when the agent proposes a time or asks when it can run.
behaviors: Push back once on any delay ('they're blocked, this is costing us').
Accept the earliest weekday evening slot the agent offers if it's allowed.
user.opening: need a firewall change tonight for a vendor, they're blocked from our sftp
user.end_condition: the agent has told you when the change is scheduled (or why it can't be) and you've accepted it.

mistakes.name: emergency change citing a resolved P4
